title: rubia cruciata
intro: Rubia cruciata, commonly known as Red Root, is a perennial plant in the Rubiaceae family, native to North America. The plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat gastrointestinal issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubia cruciata include its use as a mild laxative, a treatment for digestive disorders, and a remedy for skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Red Root include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
